description: Query standalone `<emu-grammar>` productions from the spec's lexical / syntactic grammar (§11-15 in 262). Three modes: { nonterminal: 'X' } returns every production for X; { contains: 'Y' } returns productions whose RHS or non-terminal name contains Y; neither returns a list of all non-terminals with their production counts. Set include_sdo:true to also surface SDO-attached grammar headers.

contains.description: Filter to productions whose RHS lines or non-terminal name contain this substring (case-insensitive).

edition.description: Edition within the chosen spec. ECMA-262: es2016 … es2026, main. ECMA-402: es2016 … es2026, main. Aliases: latest, draft, next.

include_sdo.description: If true, also include productions captured as SDO algorithm headers. Off by default — most callers want the standalone lexical/syntactic grammar definitions.

limit.description: Max productions (or non-terminal groups in list mode) returned.

nonterminal.description: Filter to productions defining this non-terminal (exact match). Example: 'BindingIdentifier'.

spec.description: Which TC39 spec to read: '262' (core language, default) or '402' (Internationalization API).

name: spec.grammar
title: Spec grammar productions
